topic: Compilation of the most heated football moments (managers, players, referees losing temper)
hero: Various unidentified players/managers; named in captions (Guardiola, Mourinho, Aguero)
hook: Referee and player arguing in close-up, red-clad crowd behind
subtitle_style: white bold caps with black outline captions lower-centre ('UNHAPPY AFTER BEING SUBBED OFF!', 'WTF HAPPENED THERE?!', 'COME HERE & DEFEND!')
reaction_overlays: red circle highlight rings, green arrow marker, angry emoji stickers, name tag text 'guardiola'
transition_summary: Hard cuts; each clip 4-8 s; ~3 cuts per 10 s with zoom-ins on faces
audio_note: original broadcast commentary/crowd; transcript shows commentary ('Messi and Mata offside flag against Neymar')

reuse_segments.what: Assorted broadcast clips of heated incidents
reuse_segments.how_to_reuse: licensed broadcast sources needed; recreate with licensed clips and own captions
